finding.headline: "The Village-Seeker Abroad"
finding.problem: "Back home the neighbour would just appear with soup. Here I don't even know who lives next door. I have no one who gets it."
finding.person: Newly immigrated African mum in UK/US/Canada with no kin nearby; wants the "village" she had back home but has no idea how to meet African/Black mum friends.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "Find Your Village: A Diaspora Mum's Map to African & Black Mum Friends."". Verdict: PASSES.
